inference.latency_scope: Elapsed includes image IO, preprocessing, CUDA synchronization and association; excludes model load and metric scoring.

policy.association: Same class; maximum original-box IoU, then confidence, then original crop-output index
policy.gate: Observed TRAIN only; mean IoU gain, nondecreasing strict matches, no new IoU<.50 losses
policy.preserve: Original prediction count, ordering, image, class, confidence and every unmatched/zero-area box

gate.limitation: Detector saw these TRAIN images; this is a refinement gate, not an independent detector test.
